Wait, maybe the chain doesn't require the blocks to be in the same column. Maybe it just requires them to be close vertically.

Let me try moving the green block down so it's 2-3 rows below the blue block, then see if the chain works.
Actually, let me first check if the chain is intact by trying to move UP and seeing if both green and blue blocks move.
But I can't use RIGHT to move the green block. Let me try moving UP to move the green block up, then DOWN to move it back down.
Wait, moving UP moves the green block up by 6 rows. If I move UP from the current position (player at row 30-35), the player moves to row 24-29 (top), and the green block moves up by 6 rows to row 13-16.
But the red block is at row 13-16! So moving UP would move the green block to the red block's position.
